name: Documentation

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
    tags:
      - 'v*'
    paths:
      - 'src/docs/**'
      - 'include/**'
      - 'src/bindings/**'
      - 'src/rawtoaces_core/**'
      - 'src/rawtoaces_util/**'
      - 'README.md'
      - 'CONTRIBUTING.md'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'CMakeLists.txt'
      - 'configure.cmake'
      - '.readthedocs.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/docs.yml'
      - 'build_scripts/**'
      - 'tests/docs/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/docs/**'
      - 'include/**'
      - 'src/bindings/**'
      - 'src/rawtoaces_core/**'
      - 'src/rawtoaces_util/**'
      - 'README.md'
      - 'CONTRIBUTING.md'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'CMakeLists.txt'
      - 'configure.cmake'
      - '.readthedocs.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/docs.yml'
      - 'build_scripts/**'
      - 'tests/docs/**'
  # Allow manual trigger
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Allow only one concurrent deployment
concurrency:
  group: "docs-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref || 'pages' }}"
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  validate-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install Doxygen
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y doxygen

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a309ff8b426b58ec0e2a45f0f869d46889d02405 # v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.14'

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r src/docs/requirements.txt

      - name: Test documentation validation
        run: python -m unittest discover -s tests/docs

      - name: Build and validate the proposed documentation
        run: python build_scripts/build_docs.py --repo-root . --output-dir site-preview

      - name: Upload pull-request preview
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@bbbca2ddaa5d8feaa63e36b76fdaad77386f024f # v7
        with:
          path: site-preview
          name: rawtoaces-documentation-preview
          retention-days: 5

  build-docs:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    needs: validate-docs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout publication sources
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # A tag event validates the tag above, but latest remains main.
          ref: ${{ github.ref_type == 'tag' && 'main' || github.sha }}

      - name: Install Doxygen
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y doxygen

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a309ff8b426b58ec0e2a45f0f869d46889d02405 # v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.14'

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r src/docs/requirements.txt

      - name: Build versioned publication site
        run: |
          python build_scripts/build_version

name: Checks

on:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
